name: Seru Epenisa Cakobau
contribution: A Fijian chief, monarch, and warlord who united part of Fiji's warring tribes, establishing a Fijian kingdom.

checks.lead: Ratu Seru Epenisa Cakobau (pronounced [ˈseru epeˈniːsa ðakomˈbau]; occasionally spelled Cacobau) (c. 1815 – 1 February 1883) was a Fijian chief, monarch, and warlord (Vunivalu) who united part of Fiji's warring tribes, establishing a Fijian kingdom. He served as its only king from 1871 to 1874.
